prompt: Jade races Orange around the block
title: The Big Block Race
irony: The coach who must win learns slowing down wins the race together.

beats.title: The street wakes
beats.summary: Jade and Orange tie shoes at the chalk start line while Green waves a flag on the sunny street.

beats.title: The setup
beats.summary: Jade dares Orange to race round the block while Orange boasts he never loses.

beats.title: The setup builds
beats.summary: Black bets Jade cannot win and draws the finish line as Yellow climbs to her porch to call the race.

beats.title: The hook
beats.summary: The street chants the block race as Jade and Orange crouch at the chalk start line.

beats.title: The problem
beats.summary: Jade sprints too fast past the corner while Orange charges hard and grabs his aching side.

beats.title: The problem builds
beats.summary: By the big tree Jade and Orange tangle shoelaces and hop while Black scoots past ringing his bell.

beats.title: The hook again
beats.summary: Yellow calls the stumbling runners on as the street chants the block race again.

beats.title: The turn
beats.summary: Orange sits on the curb and feels winning means nothing without joy beside him.

beats.title: The turn deepens
beats.summary: Orange offers to let go of winning and asks Jade to run the last stretch side by side.

beats.title: The hook, grown
beats.summary: Jade and Orange run shoulder to shoulder home as Orange sings slowing wins it together.

beats.title: Settle down
beats.summary: Jade and Orange cross the chalk line hand in hand as the street cheers a tied finish.
